name: dmemo
description: Private, encrypted, cross-session memory for Claude Code — captured turns are encrypted client-side and stored on 0G Storage; only your wallet key can decrypt them.

privateKey.description: dMemo wallet private key (0x...). Encrypts/decrypts your memory locally; only its ciphertext ever leaves this machine (written to 0G Storage). Leave blank to skip — dMemo fails open (no-op) until configured. Run `npx dmemo setup` for a guided wallet setup instead of pasting a key here.
